title_zh: 分清博物馆礼拜空间与世俗展区

scenario.label_zh: 馆内礼拜空间的参观礼仪
scenario.goal_zh: 确认礼拜室的拍照限制并选择先看世俗展区

context_zh: 访客 Ellis 向虚构博物馆接待员 Rose 询问馆内一间仍用于礼拜的小礼拜室。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Is the small chapel part of the museum, or is it still used for worship?

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: Both. It remains a sacred space, so we ask visitors not to take photographs inside.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: I wanted a picture of the painting of the saint above the doorway.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: There’s a reproduction in the guidebook. Photography is allowed in our secular history gallery, though.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: I’ll start in that gallery, then visit the chapel without my camera out.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: That’s fine. The history gallery is through the blue doors.
